cases.name: Niomi Lee Marie "Omi" Rose
cases.about: Her obituary said: "Niomi was born in Augusta, Georgia, to Lindzey Lee Jean Rose and Tyler Mitchell. She was a loving daughter, sister, niece, and a bright light to all who knew her. Niomi had a joyful spirit and loved being outdoors, playing with her toys, and spending time with her favorites—Bluey, Spider-Man, and Barbie. She enjoyed helping with anything around the house and had a special way of bringing happiness to everyone she met. Gone but not forgotten."
cases.narrative: Investigators say she suffered significant bruising to her chin, stomach, and back, consistent with a violent assault involving hands and possibly other objects.
